Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Sanjay Hegde. I am a 76-year-old chartered accountant living in Panaji. Ashok Sandhu gave me a cheque for Rs 8,05,000 to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 86995 84040 or email sanjay.hegde@example.com.
